content.title: How to watch Sixers vs. Nuggets and 9 p.m. newscast on NBC10
content.text: A special 9 p.m. newscast will air on NBC10 before the Philadelphia 76ers take on the Denver Nuggets. Here's how to watch. The Philadelphia 76ers (37-31) take on the Denver Nuggets (41-27) Tuesday night on NBC10 and Peacock. The shorthanded Sixers are riding a two-game winning streak despite being without Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, Paul George, and Kelly Oubre. The Nuggets are coming off an overtime loss to the Los Angeles Lakers over the weekend. With about a month left in the regular season, Tuesday night's matchup is critical for both teams. The Sixers are currently in the 9th seed in the Eastern Conference and fighting to get out of the play-in tournament while the Nuggets are the 5th seed in the Western Conference and fighting for homecourt advantage in the playoffs. You can watch the game at 10 p.m. ET live on NBC10 and here on Peacock.
